title: Which top looks better
situation: A friend sends two fitting-room selfies and asks you to pick which top to buy.
tip: When a friend asks you to choose between two things, don't just say 'both nice' — react (오/음), pick a side, and give a quick reason. A clear opinion with a why is what they actually want.

turns.ko: 야 이거 둘 중에 뭐가 나아?? 사진 보냈어ㅋㅋ
turns.en: Hey which of these two is better?? I sent pics lol

turns.prompt: React and ask what the occasion is before choosing.

choices.ko: 오 둘 다 예쁜데ㅋㅋ 어디 입고 갈 건데?
choices.en: Oh they're both cute lol where are you gonna wear it?
choices.feedback: 오 reacts, and 어디 입고 갈 건데? gets the context you need to actually help — keeps it rolling.

choices.ko: 둘 다 잘 어울리십니다.
choices.en: Both suit you well. (formal)
choices.feedback: 어울리십니다 is way too formal for texting a friend about clothes — drop the 십니다.

choices.ko: 옷 또 사? 옷장 터지겠다.
choices.en: Buying clothes again? Your closet's gonna explode.
choices.feedback: Reads as nagging when they just want a quick opinion.

turns.en: A blind date this weekend lol first impressions matter you know

turns.prompt: Pick the white one and give a quick reason.

choices.ko: 헐 소개팅?? 그럼 무조건 흰색! 깔끔해 보여
choices.en: Whoa a blind date?? then definitely the white one! looks clean
choices.feedback: Reacts to the news and commits to a pick with a reason (깔끔해 보여) — exactly the help they asked for.

choices.ko: 흰색 상의가 더 단정해 보입니다.
choices.en: The white top looks more tidy. (formal)
choices.feedback: 단정해 보입니다 is textbook-stiff — friends say 깔끔해 보여.

choices.ko: 둘 중에 뭐가 나은지 모르겠어.
choices.en: I can't tell which one's better.
choices.feedback: Dodges the question — they asked you to choose, so just pick one.

turns.ko: 오 그치? 근데 흰색은 음식 흘리면 티 나잖아ㅠ
turns.en: Oh right? but white shows stains if I spill food ㅠ

turns.prompt: Agree but reassure her and tell her to just be careful.

choices.ko: ㅋㅋㅋ 그건 그래 근데 조심하면 되지! 흰색이 훨 나아
choices.en: Lol true but just be careful! white's way better
choices.feedback: 그건 그래 validates her worry, then you hold your pick — natural back-and-forth that lands the decision.

choices.ko: 흰 옷은 오염에 취약하므로 주의가 필요합니다.
choices.en: White clothes are prone to stains so caution is needed. (formal)
choices.feedback: Sounds like a care-label warning, not a friend hyping her up.

choices.ko: 그럼 그냥 검은색 사.
choices.en: Then just buy the black one.
choices.feedback: Flip-flops the second she hesitates — wishy-washy when she wanted you to be sure.

turns.en: Okok lol decided, I'll get the white one! thanks

turns.prompt: Hype her up and tell her to send a full pic after.

choices.ko: ㅋㅋ 잘 골랐어! 입고 풀샷 한 번 보내봐
choices.en: Lol good pick! put it on and send me a full shot
choices.feedback: 잘 골랐어 closes it warmly and 풀샷 보내봐 keeps the thread alive — perfect casual sign-off.

choices.ko: 탁월한 선택이십니다. 사진 부탁드립니다.
choices.en: An excellent choice. Please send a photo. (formal)
choices.feedback: Reads like a shop clerk — friends say 잘 골랐어 / 보내봐.

choices.ko: 소개팅 잘 안 되면 옷 탓이야ㅋㅋ
choices.en: If the date flops it's the outfit's fault lol
choices.feedback: Joke lands flat — adds pressure right when she finally felt good about it.

title: Should I get a new phone
situation: A friend texts that their phone keeps dying and they're torn about whether to upgrade.
tip: When a friend is on the fence about a purchase, ask a probing question (왜? / 얼마나 됐는데?) before giving advice. Drawing out the details is how friends help each other decide.

turns.ko: 아 진짜 폰 바꿀까 말까 고민된다…
turns.en: Ugh should I get a new phone or not… I keep going back and forth

turns.prompt: Ask what's wrong with the current one.

choices.ko: 갑자기? 지금 폰 왜, 뭐 문제 있어?
choices.en: Out of nowhere? what's up with your phone, something wrong?
choices.feedback: 왜 + 뭐 문제 있어? digs into the reason before advising — that's how you actually help them decide.

choices.ko: 기기 교체를 고려 중이신가요?
choices.en: Are you considering replacing your device? (formal)
choices.feedback: 교체를 고려 중이신가요 sounds like a carrier rep — say 폰 왜, 문제 있어?

choices.ko: 응 바꿔 바꿔.
choices.en: Yeah change it change it.
choices.feedback: Snap advice with zero context — you don't even know what's wrong yet.

turns.ko: 배터리가 반나절도 안 가ㅠㅠ 산 지 4년 됐거든
turns.en: The battery doesn't even last half a day ㅠㅠ I've had it 4 years

turns.prompt: React that 4 years is a lot and lean toward upgrading.

choices.ko: 헐 4년이면 오래 썼네ㅋㅋ 그 정도면 바꿀 때 됐지
choices.en: Whoa 4 years is a long time lol at that point it's time to upgrade
choices.feedback: 헐 reacts to the detail and 바꿀 때 됐지 gives a clear, reasoned nudge — exactly what they're fishing for.

choices.ko: 4년 사용하셨다면 교체를 권장드립니다.
choices.en: If you've used it 4 years I recommend replacement. (formal)
choices.feedback: 권장드립니다 is customer-service formal — friends say 바꿀 때 됐지.

choices.ko: 배터리만 갈면 되지 않아?
choices.en: Can't you just replace the battery?
choices.feedback: Not wrong, but it sidesteps their actual lean — they clearly want to upgrade, so engage with that.

turns.ko: 근데 새 폰 너무 비싸… 백만원 훌쩍 넘던데
turns.en: but new phones are so expensive… way over a million won

turns.prompt: Sympathize and suggest a cheaper route like a deal or last year's model.

choices.ko: 그니까ㅋㅋ 미쳤어 요즘. 그냥 작년 모델 노려봐, 훨 싸
choices.en: Right lol prices are insane these days. just go for last year's model, way cheaper
choices.feedback: 그니까 commiserates and you offer a real fix (작년 모델) — keeps solving the problem together.

choices.ko: 최신 기종은 가격대가 상당히 높은 편입니다.
choices.en: The latest models are in a fairly high price range. (formal)
choices.feedback: Just restates their point in stiff 습니다 form without offering anything.

choices.ko: 돈 없으면 그냥 쓰던 거 써.
choices.en: If you're broke just keep using your old one.
choices.feedback: Comes off blunt and unhelpful — they wanted ideas, not a dead end.

turns.ko: 오 작년 모델! 그 생각은 못 했네ㅋㅋ 가성비 괜찮아?
turns.en: Oh last year's model! didn't think of that lol is the value good?

turns.prompt: Confirm it's worth it and tell her to check it out.

choices.ko: ㅇㅇ 성능 거의 똑같은데 싸ㅋㅋ 한 번 알아봐!
choices.en: Yep performance is basically the same but cheaper lol go check it out!
choices.feedback: Gives the verdict (가성비 좋다) and a nudge to act (알아봐!) — wraps the advice cleanly.

choices.ko: 가성비 측면에서 매우 합리적인 선택입니다.
choices.en: In terms of value it's a very reasonable choice. (formal)
choices.feedback: Reads like a product review. Just say 싸고 좋아, 알아봐!

choices.ko: 가성비가 뭐냐면 말이지…
choices.en: Let me explain what 'value for money' means…
choices.feedback: She knows the word — explaining it derails the chat and sounds condescending.

title: Help picking a friend's gift
situation: A friend texts you for help choosing a birthday gift for your mutual friend.
tip: When asked for a recommendation, ask about budget and the person's taste first (예산? 걔 뭐 좋아해?). Narrowing it down before suggesting is what makes the help genuinely useful.

turns.ko: 야 다음 주 지민이 생일인데 뭐 선물하지?? 도와줘ㅠ
turns.en: Hey it's Jimin's birthday next week, what should I get?? help me ㅠ

turns.prompt: Ask how much she's thinking of spending.

choices.ko: 오 벌써 생일이구나ㅋㅋ 예산 얼마 정도 생각해?
choices.en: Oh it's her birthday already lol how much are you thinking of spending?
choices.feedback: 예산 얼마? narrows it down right away — you can't recommend well without knowing the budget.

choices.ko: 예산은 어느 정도로 책정하셨습니까?
choices.en: What budget have you allocated? (formal)
choices.feedback: 책정하셨습니까 sounds like a finance meeting — say 예산 얼마 정도 생각해?

choices.ko: 선물은 마음이 중요한 거야.
choices.en: It's the thought that counts with gifts.
choices.feedback: True but useless here — she asked for actual ideas, so help her brainstorm.

turns.ko: 한 5만원 안쪽? 너무 부담 주긴 싫어서ㅋㅋ
turns.en: Like under 50k? don't wanna make it too much lol

turns.prompt: React, then ask about the friend's taste before suggesting.

choices.ko: 오케이 적당하네ㅋㅋ 근데 걔 요즘 뭐에 빠져있어?
choices.en: Okay that's reasonable lol but what's she into these days?
choices.feedback: Confirms the budget then 뭐에 빠져있어? pulls out her taste — the key to a good rec.

choices.ko: 해당 금액은 적정하다고 사료됩니다.
choices.en: That amount seems appropriate. (formal)
choices.feedback: 사료됩니다 is super stiff and old-fashioned — friends say 적당하네.

choices.ko: 5만원이면 뭐 살 수 있나?
choices.en: Can you even buy anything for 50k?
choices.feedback: Sounds dismissive of her budget — plenty of good gifts fit, so stay constructive.

turns.ko: 요즘 향수에 진심이더라구ㅋㅋ 인스타에 맨날 올려
turns.en: She's really into perfume lately lol posts it on insta all the time

turns.prompt: Light up and suggest a perfume or a diffuser.

choices.ko: 오 그럼 답 나왔네ㅋㅋ 디퓨저나 미니 향수 어때?
choices.en: Oh then we've got our answer lol how about a diffuser or a mini perfume?
choices.feedback: 답 나왔네 reacts, and two concrete options move the decision forward — solid recommending.

choices.ko: 향수 또는 디퓨저를 선물하시는 것을 추천드립니다.
choices.en: I recommend gifting a perfume or diffuser. (formal)
choices.feedback: 추천드립니다 reads like a shopping site. Just say 디퓨저나 향수 어때?

choices.ko: 향수는 취향 타서 고르기 어려워.
choices.en: Perfume's hard to pick since it's a taste thing.
choices.feedback: Shoots down the idea instead of running with the great lead she just gave you.

turns.ko: 오 디퓨저 좋다! 근데 어디서 사지? 추천 좀ㅋㅋ
turns.en: Oh a diffuser's nice! but where do I buy it? give me a rec lol

turns.prompt: Offer to send a link to a shop you know.

choices.ko: 내가 자주 가는 데 있어ㅋㅋ 링크 보내줄게!
choices.en: There's a place I go to a lot lol I'll send you the link!
choices.feedback: Offers a concrete next step (링크 보내줄게) — exactly how friends hand off a rec and keep things moving.

choices.ko: 제가 즐겨 이용하는 매장 링크를 전송해 드리겠습니다.
choices.en: I'll send you a link to the store I frequent. (formal)
choices.feedback: 전송해 드리겠습니다 is robotic — friends say 링크 보내줄게.

choices.ko: 그냥 인터넷에 검색하면 다 나와.
choices.en: Just search online, it all comes up.
choices.feedback: Brushes her off after she asked you specifically — unhelpful when you could just share a spot.
